scripts.dev:worker: npm run verify:dev && npm run db:migrate:dev && wrangler dev --env dev
scripts.verify:dev: npm run build:dev && node scripts/verify-build.mjs dev
scripts.verify:prod: npm run build:prod && node scripts/verify-build.mjs production
scripts.db:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env dev
scripts.db:migrate:dev:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env dev
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run verify:dev && wrangler deploy --env dev
